checks.what: Two independent audits read all 589 cards against Microsoft's openly licensed Azure AI documentation, which they quote word for word as found by the card checker, and checked product names against the current docs (AI-901 replaced AI-900 on 30 June 2026)
checks.result: No wrong answers; 4 unsupported claims, 5 ambiguous cards, 10 unclear ones and 11 minor issues were fixed, among them image-size limits that depend on which Vision service is meant.
